About

Built by Sorvex Labs.

Keelway exists because agent systems asked for trust they hadn't earned. We build the instrument that answers with receipts — an Apache-2.0 open core with commercial tiers for teams that need governed routing at scale.

P-01

Sovereignty is a feature

Your models, your keys, your tapes. Keelway never holds your prompts hostage — the platform runs where you put it, including air-gapped.

P-02

Every action is accountable

The execution tape is a hash-chained Merkle record. Denials are sealed too — nothing fails silently.

P-03

Governance before egress

Policy decides where a call runs before the prompt leaves the machine. Fail-closed, not best-effort.

P-04

Honest economics

0% token markup on paid tiers. You pay providers at their published rate card; we bill per seat.

Sorvex Labs

Sorvex Labs is the company behind Keelway. We build sovereign AI infrastructure — systems that keep models, keys, and records under the operator's control. Keelway is our flagship platform: an open-core agent runtime with governed frontier routing and a signed receipt for every action.
